name: Amram
overview: Amram is identified in Scripture as a key figure within the Levite lineage, being the son of Kohath and the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam through his wife Jochebed, who was also of the tribe of Levi. He served as the head of one of the Kohathite families, a significant branch among the Levites, as detailed in Exodus and Numbers. The Scriptures also note Amram's longevity, living 137 years, reflecting the enduring legacy of his family in God's redemptive plan. Additionally, other genealogical mentions connect Amram as a son of Bani and Dishon, highlighting the complexity of biblical genealogies.
